title: My Number One Goal On The First Day Of School
author: Michael Linsin
summary: Linsin reveals that his top priority on the first day of school is not routines or the management plan itself, but making students genuinely love being in his class. He argues this emotional buy-in creates leverage that makes every other classroom management strategy easier, triggers reciprocity, and causes students to relay their excitement to parents, building family support from day one. His prescription is straightforward: be warm, honest, and transparent, present the management plan as something that exists to protect students rather than control them, teach at least one routine with real energy and rigor, and let students experience an early, genuine success so they see what learning in the class will feel like all year.

You trigger the Law of Reciprocity, which causes them to want to repay you for creating a classroom they’re happy to be part of.
